exercises.noteUz: Gap “There is” bilan boshlanadi, joy oxirda keladi.

exercises.explanationUz: There are three windows — “uchta deraza bor“; in my room — “mening xonamda“.
exercises.source: There are three windows in my room.

exercises.explanationUz: Mehmonxonada katta divan bor. — There is a big sofa in the living room.

accepted: There is a big sofa in the living room.

exercises.explanationUz: Oshxonamizda uchta deraza bor. — There are three windows in our kitchen.
exercises.source: Oshxonamizda uchta deraza bor.
accepted: There are three windows in our kitchen.

exercises.explanationUz: “three chairs“ ko‘plik, shuning uchun There are kerak.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: There is three chairs in the kitchen.
There are three chairs in the kitchen.
There three chairs are in the kitchen.
There are a three chairs in the kitchen.

exercises.explanationUz: next to — yonida, on — ustida, in — ichida, under — ostida.
exercises.text: The shoes are ___ the door. The cup is ___ the table. My mother is ___ the kitchen. The cat sleeps ___ the chair.

exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: There is a lamp in my bedroom.
There are a sofa in the living room.
There are two bedrooms in the flat.
There isn’t a computer in my room.
exercises.explanationUz: Birlik → there is (a lamp, a sofa); ko‘plik → there are (two bedrooms, five rooms). Inkor: there isn’t.

exercises.text: My school bag is ___ the chair. The kitchen is ___ to the bathroom. A picture of my family is ___ the wall.
exercises.explanationUz: under — ostida; next to — yonida; on the wall — devorda.

exercises.source: Kitoblar stol ostida.
accepted: The books are under the table
The books are under the table.

exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gap — some; inkor va so‘roq gap — any.
exercises.text: We have ___ bread for breakfast. There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. Are there ___ eggs at home? I want ___ tea with sugar.

exercises.explanationUz: Countable — sanaladigan (an egg, two apples, three potatoes); uncountable — sanalmaydigan (rice, meat, sugar).
“eggs“ sanaladigan ko‘plik, shuning uchun how many.

isn’t any — “yo‘q“; in the fridge — “muzlatgichda“.

exercises.explanationUz: Sho‘rvada go‘sht yo‘q. — There isn’t any meat in the soup.

accepted: There isn’t any meat in the soup.

exercises.explanationUz: bread, water, rice, cheese — sanalmaydigan; egg, apple — sanaladigan.

exercises.question: Which words are uncountable?
exercises.explanationUz: Milk, rice, water — sanalmaydi (two milks deyilmaydi). Apple, egg — sanaladi: two apples, ten eggs.

exercises.text: There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. We buy ___ meat at the market. Are there ___ apples in the bag?
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor va so‘roq gapda — any; tasdiq gapda — some.

exercises.question: My cousin ___ play the guitar.

U bu hafta oxiri basketbol o‘ynamoqchi emas

exercises.instructionUz: Matndagi ma’lumotga qarab variantlardan birini belgilang.

exercises.question: What is on the teacher’s table?
options: Three books, a pen and a pencil

exercises.instructionUz: Bu fikr matnga ko‘ra true (to‘g‘ri), false (xato) yoki notgiven (matnda yo‘q)?

exercises.statement: Samir studies at School Number Seven.
exercises.evidence: I am a student at School Number Seven in Tashkent.

exercises.statement: Bekzod is eleven years old.
exercises.evidence: I have a new friend in my class. His name is Bekzod. He is twelve.

exercises.instructionUz: Agar matnda bu haqda hech qanday javob bo‘lmasa, notgiven deb belgilang.

exercises.statement: Samir walks to school every day.
exercises.evidence: Matnda bu haqda ma’lumot yo‘q.

exercises.text: Samir says: My ___ is Samir. There are ___ desks in his classroom. His new ___ is Bekzod.

exercises.question: How many desks are there in Samir’s classroom?

exercises.question: What does Dilnoza’s mother look like?
options: She is tall and has long black hair.
She is short with grey hair.
She has got a big red bag.
She has got a blue bike.

exercises.evidence: My family is not big: there are five people in it — my mother, my father, my little brother, my grandmother and me.

exercises.statement: Dilnoza’s father has got a blue bike.
exercises.evidence: He is short, he is quiet, and he has got a blue bike.

exercises.explanationUz: Inkor uchun to be dan keyin not qo‘yiladi: am not, is not (isn’t), are not (aren’t).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “My name is Aziza and I am twelve.”
exercises.explanationUz: “My name is ...” — “Mening ismim ...”. To be fe’li o‘zbekchada qo‘shimcha bilan ifodalanadi.
“Bu mening kitobim” = This is my book. Bu yerda is albatta kerak.

exercises.text: My name ___ Samir. I ___ eleven years old. Nurina and Bekzod ___ my friends.
exercises.explanationUz: My name — u (it) → is; I → am; Nurina and Bekzod — ular (they) → are.

exercises.text: I ___ a little brother. My sister ___ long hair. We ___ two cats.
exercises.explanationUz: I / you / we / they — have got; he / she / it — has got.

exercises.text: This is ___ mother and father (bizning). Rustam has a bike. ___ bike is blue. That girl is kind. ___ name is Aziza.
exercises.explanationUz: Onaga tegishli narsa — her, otaga — his, bizga — our, o‘quvchilarga — their.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “My grandmother's garden is small and she has got two cats.”

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “U yosh va uning uzun sochi bor.”

exercises.text: I ___ to school every day (go). My brother ___ his homework at five (do). She ___ TV in the evening (watch).

exercises.text: My father ___ work on Sunday. I ___ watch TV in the morning.
exercises.explanationUz: I / you / we / they — don’t; he / she / it — doesn’t.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “She does her homework in the evening.”

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “Men yaxshi suza olaman.”
exercises.explanationUz: “qila olaman“ = I can + fe’l; “yaxshi“ (well) — qo‘shimcha ma’noni yetkazadi.

exercises.text: Sardor ___ play football very well. His sister ___ swim. On Saturday Sardor and Farrukh ___ going to watch a film.
exercises.explanationUz: Sardor futbolni yaxshi o‘ynay oladi (can); singlisi suza olmaydi (can’t); ikki kishi (they) → are going to.

exercises.text: Yesterday ___ Saturday. I ___ at the bus stop. My friends ___ on the metro. The ticket ___ cheap.
exercises.explanationUz: I / he / she / it — was; we / you / they — were.

exercises.question: My brother and I ___ at the airport yesterday.
exercises.explanationUz: “My brother and I“ — ikki kishi (they), shuning uchun were.

exercises.text: The bus stop is ___ the gate. The airport is not ___ — it is near. Go ___ ahead and turn ___ at the crossing.
exercises.explanationUz: next to — yonida; far — uzoq; straight ahead — to‘g‘ri; turn left — chapga.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “Excuse me, how do I get to the airport?”
exercises.explanationUz: “how do I get to“ — “... qanday boraman“.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “Kecha men uyda edim.”
exercises.explanationUz: kecha — yesterday, men — I, edim — was.

exercises.text: Go straight ahead and turn ___ at the crossing. The museum is ___ to the blue gate. Last weekend we ___ in Samarkand.
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda: “turn left at the crossing”, “next to the blue gate”; we → were.

exercises.question: How old is Samir?
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda: “I am eleven years old.” (Bekzod o‘n ikki yoshda, uni aralashtirmang.)

exercises.text: Samir says: My ___ is Samir. There are ___ desks in his classroom. His new ___ is Bekzod.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: name / twenty / friend — barchasi matnda so‘zma-so‘z bor.

exercises.question: How many people are there in Dilnoza’s family?
exercises.explanationUz: “there are five people in it — my mother, my father, my little brother, my grandmother and me.”

exercises.text: Dilnoza’s mother is ___ and she has long ___ hair. Sanjar has got a big ___ bag.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: tall, black, red — uchala so‘z ham matnda bor.

exercises.question: What time does school start?
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinchi paragrafda: “School starts at eight o’clock.”

exercises.question: Which subject does Aziza like most?
exercises.explanationUz: “My favourite subject is English.”

exercises.text: Aziza wakes up at ___ past six. She is never ___ at school. In the afternoon she does her ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Javoblar: half, late, homework — matndagi so‘zlar.

exercises.question: How many rooms are there in the flat?
exercises.explanationUz: Birinchi paragraf: “There are five rooms: a living room, two bedrooms, a kitchen and a bathroom.“

exercises.question: Where is the school bag?
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinchi paragraf: “my school bag is under the chair“.

exercises.text: There are five rooms in my flat. My school bag is ___ the chair. A picture is ___ the wall. There ___ no computers in our rooms, but there ___ a soft sofa in the living room.
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda “five rooms“ deyilgan — are; sumka stul ostida — under; rasm devor ustida — on; “computers“ ko‘plik — bo‘sh joyga are (so‘z “There“ allaqachon yozilgan).

exercises.text: We need ___ food for the weekend. There isn’t ___ milk in the fridge. Are there ___ apples in the bag? I like ___ soup.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gap — some; inkor va so‘roq — any; like’den keyin — cooking.

exercises.question: What can Sardor do very well?
exercises.explanationUz: Birinchi paragraf: “I can play football very well.“

exercises.text: Sardor ___ ride a bike for two hours. His sister can’t ___. On Sunday he ___ going to ride bikes in the hills with his father.
exercises.explanationUz: Qobiliyat — can / can’t; reja — am going to.

exercises.question: How does the writer go to school every day?
exercises.explanationUz: Birinchi paragraf: “I go to school by bus every day.“

exercises.question: How long were they on the train?
exercises.explanationUz: Ikkinchi paragraf: “We were on a big train for three hours“.

exercises.text: Yesterday ___ Saturday. My family and I ___ at the railway station. To get to the museum, go straight ahead and turn ___ at the crossing.
exercises.explanationUz: “Yesterday was ...“, “we were ...“, yo‘lda esa “turn left“ deyiladi.

exercises.question: Who is Nurina?
exercises.explanationUz: Boshida u o‘zini “I am your English teacher” deb tanishtiradi.

exercises.question: How old is Bekzod?
exercises.explanationUz: Bekzod: “I am twelve years old.”

exercises.text: Samir says: Hello, my ___ is Samir. I am ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Samir shunday deydi: my name is Samir. I am eleven.

exercises.question: How old is Nilufar?
exercises.explanationUz: Nilufar haqida: “She is fifteen and she is tall like my father.”

exercises.text: Sardor says: My father is ___ and he has got short ___ hair.
exercises.explanationUz: “My father is tall and he has got short black hair.”

exercises.question: What time does school start for Bekzod?
exercises.explanationUz: “School starts at eight o’clock and we have six lessons.”

exercises.text: Bekzod says: I wake up at ___ thirty in the morning and I get up ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Bekzod shunday deydi: “I wake up at six thirty … and I get up fast.”

exercises.question: Where do the girls talk?
exercises.explanationUz: Boshida Aziza “Welcome to my home. Come in“ deydi — suhbat undining uyida.

exercises.question: Where is the TV?
exercises.explanationUz: Transkript: “The TV is next to the window, under the picture.“

exercises.text: In the living room the TV is next to the ___. Then the girls go to the ___. Boni the cat is ___ the bed. Tomorrow the girls want to do ___ together.
exercises.explanationUz: Avval mehmonxona, keyin oshxona ko‘rsatiladi; televizor deraza yonida; mushuk karavot ostida; ertaga uy vazifasi qilishadi.

exercises.question: What food is already on the table?
exercises.explanationUz: Ona: “there is some bread on the table. There are two eggs too.“ — javob non va tuxum. Pishloq umuman yo‘q, asal stol ustidagi yashil piyolada, guruch qutida, banan esa eshik yonidagi sumkada.

exercises.text: For breakfast there is bread and there are two ___. There isn’t any ___ in the fridge. Sanjar wants a ___ and some water. He can make ___ and eggs for lunch.
exercises.explanationUz: Non va tuxum bor; pishloq yo‘q; Sanjar banan va suv so‘raydi; u tushlikka guruch va tuxum pishira oladi.

exercises.text: On Saturday the boys are going to play ___ in the park. Sardor can bring water and some ___. Farrukh wants his ___ in the park. On Sunday Sardor is going to ___ a bike with his father.
exercises.explanationUz: Futbol — Shanba; Sardor suv va olma olib keladi; Farrukh gitara olib kelishini so‘raydi; Sardor Yakshanba velosipedda boradi.

exercises.question: Where does the tourist want to go?

exercises.question: How can the tourist go to the station?
exercises.explanationUz: “You can take the metro to the station“ va “the metro is fast and clean, so take it“.

exercises.text: The tourist must turn ___ at the crossing. The metro finishes at ___ o’clock. Yesterday the tourist ___ on a bus for three hours. A ticket can be bought at the small ___ next to the gate.
exercises.explanationUz: Chorrahada chapga buriladi; metro soat o‘n birda (eleven) tugaydi; kecha sayyoh avtobusda edi; bilet kichkina derachadan olinadi.

exercises.question: Which word means "sinf xonasi"?
exercises.explanationUz: “sinf xonasi” = classroom.

exercises.text: Ten and five is ___. Nine and nine is ___.
exercises.explanationUz: 10 + 5 = 15 (fifteen), 9 + 9 = 18 (eighteen).

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “Goodbye, see you tomorrow!”
exercises.explanationUz: Goodbye — xayr, ko‘rishguncha.

exercises.explanationUz: O‘qituvchi: See you at eight o’clock.

exercises.explanationUz: Sardor: “My father is tall and he has got short black hair.”
‘Otamning velosipedi’ = My father's bike.

exercises.text: School starts ___ eight o’clock. We have an English lesson ___ Monday. I do my homework ___ the afternoon.
exercises.explanationUz: Soat — at, hafta kuni — on, kunduz qismi — in.

exercises.question: My sister ___ TV in the evening.
exercises.explanationUz: My sister — uchinchi shaxs yagona: watches.

exercises.question: Where does Aziza have lunch?
exercises.explanationUz: “We have lunch at twelve o’clock at school.”

exercises.text: We have lessons from ___ to Friday. The weekend days are ___ and ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “U kechqurun soat to‘qqizda uxlaydi.”

exercises.question: Which word means "oshxona"?
exercises.explanationUz: “oshxona“ = kitchen.

exercises.question: The pillow is ___ the bed.
exercises.explanationUz: Yostiq karavot ustida — on (“ustida“).

exercises.question: ___ three lamps in the shop.
exercises.explanationUz: “three lamps“ ko‘plik, shuning uchun There are.

exercises.text: There ___ one window in my room. There ___ two doors. Two and one is ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “Mehmonxonada katta divan bor.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Mehmonxonada katta divan bor“ = There is a big sofa in the living room.

exercises.text: My father enjoys ___ dinner. There is ___ bread on the table. There isn’t ___ tea in the cup.

exercises.explanationUz: “can“dan keyin fe’l o‘z shaklida — sing.

exercises.text: I ___ dance, but I ___ swim. On Sunday I ___ going to ride a bike.
exercises.explanationUz: Iloj bor — can, yo‘q — can’t; reja — am going to.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “Men ertaga kinoteatrga bormoqchiman.”

exercises.question: She ___ a teacher and I ___ her student.
exercises.explanationUz: “She“ — uchinchi shaxs yagona, shuning uchun is.

exercises.question: My uncle’s daughter is my ___.
exercises.explanationUz: Amaki yoki toqaning qizi/o‘g‘li ingliz tilida “cousin“ deyiladi.

exercises.text: Every morning I ___ up at half past six. Then I ___ breakfast with my family at seven o’clock.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe’llarni Past Simple shaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: To‘g‘ri fe’llarga -ed qo‘shiladi: visit → visited, cook → cooked, watch → watched, play → played.
exercises.text: Last Saturday I ___ (visit) my aunt. She ___ (cook) plov. In the evening we ___ (watch) a film and my cousins ___ (play) chess.

exercises.explanationUz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe’lda y → i bo‘ladi: study → studied.
exercises.question: What is the past form of “study”?

exercises.explanationUz: Inkorda did not (didn’t) dan keyin fe’l -ed siz keladi: didn’t watch, didn’t clean.
exercises.text: I ___ TV yesterday. My brother ___ his room on Sunday.

exercises.instructionUz: Grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri so‘roq gapni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz: So‘roqda did ishlatiladi va asosiy fe’l boshlang‘ich shaklda qoladi: Did you visit …?
exercises.question: Which question is correct?

exercises.instructionUz: So‘zlardan to‘g‘ri tartibda so‘roq gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz: Tartib: Wh-so‘z + did + ega + fe’l + qolgan qism: Where did you go last weekend?

exercises.instructionUz: Inglizcha gapni o‘zbek tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Didn’t enjoy” — inkor: “yoqmadi / zavqlanmadi”. Last Sunday = o‘tgan yakshanba.
exercises.source: We didn’t enjoy the film last Sunday.

exercises.explanationUz: O‘tgan dam olish kunlari Buxorodagi bobom va buvimnikiga bordik. — Last weekend we visited our grandparents in Bukhara.
exercises.source: O‘tgan dam olish kunlari Buxorodagi bobom va buvimnikiga bordik.
accepted: Last weekend we visited our grandparents in Bukhara.

exercises.explanationUz: Opam kecha imtihoniga tayyorlandi. — My sister studied for her exam yesterday.
exercises.source: Opam kecha imtihoniga tayyorlandi.
accepted: My sister studied for her exam yesterday.

exercises.instructionUz: Past Simple’da to‘g‘ri yozilgan gaplarni belgilang.
exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: “Did she cooked” — did bilan -ed qo‘shilmaydi; “studyed” — to‘g‘risi studied.

exercises.instructionUz: Har bo‘shliq uchun mos shaklni tanlang.
exercises.text: Yesterday I ___ my grandmother. We ___ watch TV. ___ you call her too?
exercises.explanationUz: Yesterday — o‘tgan zamon: visited; inkorda didn’t; so‘roqda Did.

exercises.instructionUz: Malikaning shanba kunini voqealar tartibida joylashtiring.
exercises.question: Matndagi voqealar ketma-ketligi.
items: They arrived by train at ten o’clock.
They visited the Registan.
Dilnoza’s mother cooked plov.
The girls talked until midnight.
itemsShuffled: Dilnoza’s mother cooked plov.
The girls talked until midnight.
They arrived by train at ten o’clock.
They visited the Registan.
exercises.explanationUz: Ertalab yetib kelishdi → kunduzi Registon → kechqurun palov → yarim tungacha suhbat.

exercises.instructionUz: O‘zbekcha gapni ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: “Uch kun oldin” = three days ago — ago vaqtdan keyin keladi. Fe’l Past Simple’da: visited.
exercises.source: Men uch kun oldin buvimnikiga bordim.
accepted: I visited my grandmother three days ago
I visited my grandma three days ago
Three days ago I visited my grandmother
I visited my granny three days ago

exercises.instructionUz: Bo‘sh joyga mos vaqt iborasini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “Ago” vaqtdan keyin keladi: two weeks ago. “Last” esa vaqtdan oldin: last week.
exercises.question: I started this course two weeks ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Fe’llarni o‘tgan zamon qo‘shimchasi bo‘yicha saralang.
exercises.explanationUz: arrived, danced; carried, tried; planned, dropped.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni o‘tgan zamon shaklida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, give → gave — bu shakllar yod olinadi.
exercises.text: Yesterday we ___ (go) to the zoo. We ___ (see) a big lion. We ___ (eat) ice cream and my uncle ___ (give) me a balloon.

exercises.instructionUz: Bo‘sh joylarga was yoki were qo‘ying.
exercises.explanationUz: I / he / she / it — was; you / we / they — were.
exercises.text: When I ___ six, my sister ___ ten. We ___ always together and our parents ___ very happy.

exercises.explanationUz: Did bilan fe’l boshlang‘ich shaklda: Did you have …? “Did you had” — xato.
exercises.question: Which question is correct?

exercises.instructionUz: To be fe’li bilan to‘g‘ri tuzilgan so‘roqni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz: Was / were bilan so‘roqda did ishlatilmaydi: Were you happy?
exercises.question: Which question is correct?

exercises.explanationUz: When + ega + was …, ega + fe’l: When I was seven I got a bike.
“Made a kite for me” — “menga varrak yasab berdi”.

accepted: When I was a child, we lived in a village.

exercises.instructionUz: Noto‘g‘ri (irregular) fe’llarning to‘g‘ri o‘tgan zamon shakllarini belgilang.
exercises.question: Which past forms are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: see → saw, make → made. “seed”, “maked” — xato.

exercises.text: When I ___ seven, we ___ to Tashkent. ___ you happy there?
exercises.explanationUz: I → was; o‘tgan zamon: moved; you → Were you …?
play, climb, remember — -ed bilan; swim, tell, break — alohida shakl.

exercises.instructionUz: Akmal bilan bo‘lgan voqeani tartib bilan joylashtiring.
exercises.question: Matndagi voqea ketma-ketligi.
items: The children climbed the trees.
Akmal fell from a tree.
He broke his arm.
The neighbour took him to the doctor.
itemsShuffled: He broke his arm.
The neighbour took him to the doctor.
The children climbed the trees.
Akmal fell from a tree.
exercises.explanationUz: Daraxtga chiqishdi → Akmal yiqildi → qo‘li sindi → qo‘shni shifokorga olib bordi.
Inkorda didn’t + boshlang‘ich shakl: didn’t see, didn’t take. To be bilan: wasn’t.
exercises.text: I ___ (not see) the film. He ___ (not take) his umbrella. It ___ (not be) cold.

exercises.explanationUz: “Bolaligimda” = When I was a child; yashardik — lived (Past Simple).
exercises.source: Bolaligimda biz qishloqda yashardik.
accepted: When I was a child we lived in a village
When I was a child, we lived in a village
We lived in a village when I was a child

exercises.explanationUz: cheap → cheaper, big → bigger (undosh ikkilanadi), easy → easier (y → i).
exercises.text: Fruit is ___ (cheap) in the village. My flat is ___ (big) than yours. This test is ___ (easy) than the last one.

exercises.explanationUz: Expensive — uzun sifat, shuning uchun more expensive.
exercises.question: A taxi is ___ than a bus.

exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni darajasi bo‘yicha tartiblang: oddiy → qiyosiy → orttirma.
exercises.question: good so‘zining darajalari.
items: good
better
the best
itemsShuffled: the best
good
better

the biggest, the most beautiful, the best (good — noto‘g‘ri sifat).

exercises.explanationUz: bad → worse → the worst. “Badder” yoki “more bad” deyilmaydi.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The traffic is more bad today.

exercises.source: Qishloqdagi hayot shahardagidan tinchroq.
accepted: Life in the village is quieter than life in the city.

exercises.source: Metro taksidan tezroq va arzonroq.
accepted: The metro is faster and cheaper than a taxi.

A village is quieter than a city
Village is quieter than the city
The countryside is quieter than the city

exercises.question: Which forms are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: cheap → cheaper (more cheap emas), good → better (gooder emas).

exercises.text: The metro is faster ___ the bus. It is ___ fastest way to travel. A taxi is ___ expensive.
exercises.explanationUz: Qiyosda than; orttirmada the; uzun sifat oldidan more.

exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni qiyosiy darajasi qanday yasalishiga qarab saralang.
exercises.explanationUz: cheaper, quieter, safer; more expensive, more modern, more crowded.

exercises.instructionUz: “as … as” tuzilmasi to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan gapni tanlang.

options: Bukhara is not as bigger as Tashkent.
Bukhara is not as big as Tashkent.
Bukhara is not so big than Tashkent.
Bukhara is not as big than Tashkent.

accepted: I think it will be very hot in July.

exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: I’m going to visit my aunt.

exercises.explanationUz: Ever / never / yet — tajriba va natija (Present Perfect); aniq o‘tgan vaqt — Past Simple.

items: Have you ever been to Istanbul?

Did you like it?
Yes, it was beautiful!
itemsShuffled: Did you like it?
Yes, it was beautiful!
Have you ever been to Istanbul?
Yes, I have. I went there last spring.

options: I have been to Turkey last year.
I went to Turkey last year.
I have went to Turkey last year.
I have go to Turkey last year.

exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan gaplarni belgilang.
exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
exercises.explanationUz: “have went” — 3-shakl gone bo‘lishi kerak; “in 2021” — aniq vaqt, Past Simple kerak.

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: You should to see a doctor.

exercises.text: I ___ get up at six. My sister ___ take her medicine. We ___ wear a uniform at school.

exercises.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: He should to see a doctor.

exercises.source: Isitmangiz bor. Uyda qolib, dam olishingiz kerak.
accepted: You have a fever. You should stay at home and rest.

exercises.source: Bu dorini ovqatdan keyin ichishingiz shart.
accepted: You must take this medicine after meals.

items: What’s the matter?
I have a bad headache.
You should rest and drink water.
Do I have to take medicine?
No, you don’t have to.

No, you don’t have to.
What’s the matter?
Do I have to take medicine?
I have a bad headache.

exercises.text: Last Saturday I ___ (visit) my aunt. She ___ (cook) plov. In the evening we ___ (watch) a film and my cousins ___ (play) chess.

exercises.explanationUz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe’lda y → i bo‘ladi: study → studied.

exercises.text: I ___ TV yesterday. My brother ___ his room on Sunday.

exercises.text: Yesterday we ___ (go) to the zoo. We ___ (see) a big lion. We ___ (eat) ice cream and my uncle ___ (give) me a balloon.

exercises.text: When I ___ six, my sister ___ ten. We ___ always together and our parents ___ very happy.
exercises.explanationUz: I / he / she / it — was; you / we / they — were.

exercises.explanationUz: Was / were bilan so‘roqda did ishlatilmaydi: Were you happy?

exercises.text: I ___ (not see) the film. He ___ (not take) his umbrella. It ___ (not be) cold.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkorda didn’t + boshlang‘ich shakl: didn’t see, didn’t take. To be bilan: wasn’t.

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “Bolaligimda biz qishloqda yashardik.”

exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimani so‘zlardan tuzing: “My grandfather made a kite for me.”
exercises.explanationUz: “Made a kite for me” — “menga varrak yasab berdi”.

exercises.text: When I ___ seven, we ___ to Tashkent. ___ you happy there?

exercises.question: You: That’s ___ mother. Her name is Dilnoza.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Erkak qarindosh — “brother” (aka/uka); “sister” — opa/singil. To‘liq: “He’s my brother. He is a doctor.” — U mening akam. U shifokor.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: And the tall man?
exercises.question: You: He’s my ___. He is a doctor.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “I” bilan “have got” ishlatiladi; “has got” — he/she uchun. To‘liq: “Yes, I have got one sister. She is ten.” — Ha, bitta singlim bor. U o‘n yoshda.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: Have you got any sisters?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I ___ got one sister. She is ten.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Soat bilan “at”: at seven o’clock, at 8:30. To‘liq: “I usually get up at seven o’clock.” — Odatda soat yettida turaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Classmate: Let’s go to the library tomorrow. What time do you get up?
exercises.question: You: I usually get up ___ seven o’clock.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Present Simple, “I” bilan fe’l o‘zgarmaydi: I have breakfast. To‘liq: “I have breakfast at half past seven.” — Yetti yarimda nonushta qilaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Classmate: And when do you have breakfast?
exercises.question: You: I ___ breakfast at half past seven.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Uchrashuv ertaga — “See you tomorrow”. To‘liq: “Great! See you tomorrow.” — Zo‘r! Ertaga ko‘rishguncha.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Classmate: OK. Let’s meet at nine.
exercises.question: You: Great! See you ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Biror narsa borligini so‘rash: Is there a…? / There is a… To‘liq: “It’s nice. Is there a TV?” — Yaxshi ekan. Televizor bormi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Landlord: Welcome! This is the living room.
exercises.question: You: It’s nice. Is ___ a TV?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Sirt ustida — “on”: on the table. Ichida — “in”: in the box. To‘liq: “And where are the keys? Are they on the table?” — Kalitlar qayerda? Ular stol ustidami?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Landlord: Yes, there is. It’s next to the window.
exercises.question: You: And where are the keys? Are they ___ the table?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “bedrooms” — ko‘plik, shuning uchun “are there”. To‘liq: “How many bedrooms are there?” — Nechta yotoqxona bor?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Landlord: No, they are in the kitchen, in the drawer.
exercises.question: You: How many bedrooms ___ there?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Xushmuomala so‘rov: “Can I have…, please?” To‘liq: “Can I have a cup of tea, please?” — Bir piyola choy olsam bo‘ladimi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Waiter: Hello! What would you like?
exercises.question: You: ___ I have a cup of tea, please?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “sandwich” undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi va sanaladi → a sandwich. To‘liq: “Yes, I’d like a sandwich, please.” — Ha, bitta sendvich olaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Waiter: Of course. Anything to eat?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I’d like ___ sandwich, please.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Narx so‘rash: “How much is it?” To‘liq: “OK, some soup, then. How much is it?” — Mayli, unda sho‘rva. Qancha turadi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Waiter: Sorry, we haven’t got any sandwiches today. We’ve got soup.
exercises.question: You: OK, some soup, then. How ___ is it?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Imkoniyat yo‘qligi “can’t” bilan: I can’t come. To‘liq: “Sorry, I can’t come on Saturday. I work.” — Kechir, shanba kuni kela olmayman. Ishlayman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: I’m going to watch a film on Saturday. Can you come?
exercises.question: You: Sorry, I ___ come on Saturday. I work.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Reja: be going TO + fe’l — I’m going to visit. To‘liq: “Sunday is OK. I’m going to visit my grandmother in the morning, but I’m free in the evening.” — Yakshanba bo‘ladi. Ertalab buvimnikiga bormoqchiman, lekin kechqurun bo‘shman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: What about Sunday?
exercises.question: You: Sunday is OK. I’m going ___ visit my grandmother in the morning, but I’m free in the evening.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: love / like dan keyin fe’l -ing bilan: I love watching… To‘liq: “Yes, I love watching comedies!” — Ha, komediya ko‘rishni juda yaxshi ko‘raman!
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: Great! Do you like comedies?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I love ___ comedies!

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Joy so‘rash — “where”: Where is…? To‘liq: “Excuse me, where is the railway station?” — Kechirasiz, temir yo‘l vokzali qayerda?
exercises.question: You: Excuse me, ___ is the railway station?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Aniq nuqtada burilish — “at”: turn left at the bridge. To‘liq: “Turn left at the bridge. OK.” — Ko‘prikda chapga burilaman. Tushunarli.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Passer-by: Go straight on and turn left at the bridge.
exercises.question: You: Turn left ___ the bridge. OK.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: O‘tgan zamon, “I” bilan → was: I was lost. To‘liq: “Is it far? Yesterday I was lost here!” — Uzoqmi? Kecha shu yerda adashib qolgandim!
exercises.passageExcerpt: Passer-by: Then the station is on your right, next to the museum.
exercises.question: You: Is it far? Yesterday I ___ lost here!

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Tugagan voqea — Past Simple: visit + -ed = visited. To‘liq: “It was great, thanks. We visited Samarkand for a week.” — Zo‘r o‘tdi, rahmat. Bir hafta Samarqandga borib keldik.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Colleague: Welcome back! How was your holiday?
exercises.question: You: It was great, thanks. We ___ Samarkand for a week.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Past Simple: walk → walked. To‘liq: “We walked around the old city and took lots of photos.” — Eski shahar bo‘ylab sayr qildik va ko‘p surat oldik.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Colleague: Lovely! What did you do there?
exercises.question: You: We ___ around the old city and took lots of photos.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Did you…? savoliga qisqa javob: Yes, I did / No, I didn’t. To‘liq: “Yes, I did. The plov was amazing!” — Ha, yoqdi. Palov ajoyib edi!
exercises.passageExcerpt: Colleague: Did you like the food?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I ___. The plov was amazing!

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Bitta uy, o‘tgan zamon → was. To‘liq: “I grew up in a small village. Our house was near a river.” — Kichik qishloqda o‘sganman. Uyimiz daryo yonida edi.
exercises.passageExcerpt: New friend: Where did you grow up?
exercises.question: You: I grew up in a small village. Our house ___ near a river.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: play → played (y dan oldin unli bo‘lsa, -ed oddiy qo‘shiladi). To‘liq: “We played football every day after school.” — Har kuni maktabdan keyin futbol o‘ynardik.
exercises.passageExcerpt: New friend: What games did you play?
exercises.question: You: We ___ football every day after school.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “teach” — noto‘g‘ri fe’l: teach → taught. To‘liq: “Mr Karimov. He taught us a lot about nature.” — Karimov domla. U bizga tabiat haqida ko‘p narsa o‘rgatgan.
exercises.passageExcerpt: New friend: Who was your favourite teacher?
exercises.question: You: Mr Karimov. He ___ us a lot about nature.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Ikki narsani solishtirish: qisqa sifat + -er → faster. To‘liq: “To Bukhara. Which is faster, the train or the bus?” — Buxoroga. Qaysi biri tezroq: poyezdmi yoki avtobus?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Ticket clerk: Good afternoon. Where are you travelling to?
exercises.question: You: To Bukhara. Which is ___, the train or the bus?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Uzun sifat bilan qiyos: more + sifat + than → more expensive than. To‘liq: “Is it more expensive than the bus?” — U avtobusdan qimmatroqmi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Ticket clerk: The fast train. It takes four hours.
exercises.question: You: Is it ___ expensive than the bus?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “return ticket” — borib-kelish; “single” — faqat bir tomonga. To‘liq: “OK, one return ticket, please.” — Mayli, bitta borib-kelish chiptasi, iltimos.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Ticket clerk: A little. A return ticket is 200,000 sums.
exercises.question: You: OK, one ___ ticket, please.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Oldindan qilingan reja: be going to + fe’l. To‘liq: “I’m going to go hiking in the mountains.” — Tog‘da piyoda sayrga chiqmoqchiman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: What are your plans for the weekend?
exercises.question: You: I’m ___ to go hiking in the mountains.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Bashorat (ob-havo) — will + fe’l: it will be sunny. To‘liq: “They say it will be sunny on Saturday.” — Shanba kuni quyoshli bo‘lishini aytishyapti.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: Do you know the weather forecast?
exercises.question: You: They say it ___ be sunny on Saturday.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror yoki va’da — will: I’ll call you. To‘liq: “Of course! I will call you tonight with the details.” — Albatta! Kechqurun qo‘ng‘iroq qilib, tafsilotlarini aytaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Friend: Sounds great. Can I come too?
exercises.question: You: Of course! I ___ call you tonight with the details.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Have you ever…? savoliga qisqa javob: Yes, I have / No, I haven’t. To‘liq: “Yes, I have. I worked at a hotel in Tashkent last year.” — Ha, ishlaganman. O‘tgan yili Toshkentdagi mehmonxonada ishladim.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Manager: Have you ever worked in a hotel?
exercises.question: You: Yes, I ___. I worked at a hotel in Tashkent last year.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Inkor va savolda “yet” — hali: not yet. To‘liq: “Not yet. I finish next month.” — Hali yo‘q. Keyingi oy tugataman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Manager: Good. Have you finished your English course?
exercises.question: You: Not ___. I finish next month.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “never” — hech qachon: I’ve never used it. To‘liq: “No, I’ve never used it, but I learn quickly.” — Yo‘q, hech foydalanmaganman, lekin tez o‘rganaman.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Manager: And have you used our booking system before?
exercises.question: You: No, I’ve ___ used it, but I learn quickly.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat: have had … for three days. To‘liq: “I have had a headache for three days.” — Uch kundan beri boshim og‘riyapti.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Doctor: What’s the problem?
exercises.question: You: I ___ a headache for three days.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Maslahat so‘rash — should: What should I do? To‘liq: “Not really. What should I do?” — Unchalik emas. Nima qilishim kerak?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Doctor: Do you sleep well? Do you drink enough water?
exercises.question: You: Not really. What ___ I do?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Majburiyat: have to + fe’l → Do I have to take…? To‘liq: “Do I have to take any medicine?” — Biror dori ichishim kerakmi?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Doctor: You should sleep eight hours and drink more water. You mustn’t work late.
exercises.question: You: Do I have ___ take any medicine?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: Tasdiq gapda — some: I need some tomatoes. To‘liq: “Yes, please. I need some tomatoes and some rice.” — Ha, iltimos. Menga bir nechta pomidor va bir oz guruch kerak.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Shop assistant: Hello! Can I help you?
exercises.question: You: Yes, please. I need ___ tomatoes and some rice.

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “rice” — sanalmaydi → how much; sanaladigan → how many. To‘liq: “A kilo, please. And how much rice do I need for six people?” — Bir kilo, iltimos. Olti kishiga qancha guruch kerak?
exercises.passageExcerpt: Shop assistant: How many tomatoes would you like?
exercises.question: You: A kilo, please. And how ___ rice do I need for six people?

exercises.instructionUz: Suhbatni davom ettiring: bo‘sh joyga mos variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz: “a lot of” — ko‘p (sanaladigan ham, sanalmaydigan ham). To‘liq: “No, thanks. I’ve got a lot of onions at home.” — Yo‘q, rahmat. Uyda piyoz ko‘p.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Shop assistant: About one kilo. Do you need any onions?
exercises.question: You: No, thanks. I’ve got a ___ of onions at home.
